youtube.description:
Sing Pat-a-Cake, Baker's Man with Robo the baker, Pip, Cat and Duck, and learn to clap a pattern and the letters B, C and D! Clap, pat, clap, pat: copy the pattern and guess which comes next. Then roll the dough, pat it, mark it with a letter and put it in the oven. Three, two, one, ding! Out comes a cake with B for baby, C for Cat and D for Duck. What letter is this? A point-to-it quiz and the whole song together.

What your child learns: an AB clapping pattern (clap, pat, clap, pat), copying a pattern and saying what comes next, and the capital letters B, C and D (B for baby, C for Cat, D for Duck).

Sing at home: sit facing your child, clap your hands, then pat your laps, and keep the clap, pat pattern going while you sing. On "mark it with B", draw a B in the air or on your child's tummy. Pat-a-Cake is a traditional public-domain rhyme; the tune here is a simple sing-song arrangement of the chant, and the verses for Cat and Duck and the story are original, written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.

do.text: Let's bake three cakes with letters!
Who gets the last cake? A surprise!
Clap, pat, clap, pat. A pattern!
A cake for baby Pip! Mix, mix, mix!
bake me a cake as fast as you can,
roll it and pat it and mark it with B,
and put it in the oven for baby and me.
What comes next? Clap or pat?
Yes! Pat! Clap, pat, clap, pat!
Hello! Can I have a cake?
A cake for Cat! Mix, mix, mix!
bake me a cake as fast as you can,
roll it and pat it and mark it with C,
and put it in the oven for Kitty and me.
Meow! Thank you! My C cake!
What comes next? Clap or pat?
Yes! Clap! Pat, clap, pat, clap!
Listen! Who gets the last cake?
A cake for Duck! Mix, mix, mix!
bake me a cake as fast as you can,
roll it and pat it and mark it with D,
and put it in the oven for Duckie and me.
Quack! A D cake for me!
Which cake has the letter B? Point to it!
Yes! B! B is for baby!
Three cakes! Everybody clap and sing!
bake me a cake as fast as you can,
roll it and pat it and mark it with B,
and put it in the oven for baby and me.
